description: A contemporary three-seater sofa featuring a plush, textured grey fabric upholstery. The sofa has a clean, modern silhouette with generously padded seat and back cushions, all trimmed with a subtle white piping that adds definition. Two accent pillows are placed on the sofa, one with a delicate leaf pattern in grey and white, and another plain light grey one. The sofa is supported by elegant, subtly ornate silver-colored legs that give it a sophisticated lift. A warm, wood-toned accent band is visible along the base between the legs, adding a touch of natural warmth to the overall design. This sofa is designed for comfort and style, fitting seamlessly into a variety of living spaces.
